name: TestFontRoboto

source.verification: Release asset of googlefonts/roboto-3-classic v3.016 (2026-06-17); its SHA-256 matches the GitHub release asset digest. hinted/static/Roboto-Regular.ttf, -Bold.ttf, -Italic.ttf, -BoldItalic.ttf and -Light.ttf were extracted byte for byte from the archive. The archive has no license file, so OFL.txt was taken from the same tag (raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/roboto-3-classic/v3.016/OFL.txt).

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.

The Bold, Italic, BoldItalic and Light faces are the typefaces of the UE 5.8 editor core styles that the UiDemo widget gallery shows (Docs/Design/UiToolkit section 9.1 UW4); they stay test data until the engine default font asset (font design FT3) exists.
